purpose: Teach: 埋まっ/労組/貸出/定休/代え/所存/営ん/取調べ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室、機材で埋まってないか?
lines.en: Ren — is your lab getting buried under equipment?
lines.style: Measured, direct inquiry. Not accusing — genuinely checking in. The tone of someone who asks because they've seen this pattern before. Slight pause after the name, letting it land as a point of attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。労組について経済学の論文を読みました
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've been reading economics papers on labor unions.
lines.style: Straightforward, slightly defensive in its clarity. Eager to show he's been working. Speaks at a steady, careful pace — each word deliberate, nothing wasted. The earnestness of proving oneself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、図書館の貸出制度、活用しろ
lines.en: Then use the library's lending system. Don't just hoard everything in the lab.
lines.style: Practical, not unkind. A quick jab of wisdom — brief enough to sting a little but grounded in real advice. The tone of a mentor who expects the student will actually listen.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授の定休日、把握しております
lines.en: Understood, sir. I'm aware of your office hours.
lines.style: Formal, respectful. Almost rehearsed — the careful speech of someone trying to absorb and implement feedback immediately. Slightly stiff in its precision, but genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究テーマを代えての挑戦も検討しろ
lines.en: And consider switching your research focus. A fresh angle might serve you better.
lines.style: Deliberate, calm authority. Not a suggestion — a gentle insistence. Eyes steady on him. The words land with weight because they're spoken without pressure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、博士取得まで頑張る所存です
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm committed to earning my doctorate.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath the formality. A slight lift in the voice — determination without arrogance. He means it. Sits straighter as he says it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究を続けて営んでいけ
lines.en: Good. Keep pushing forward with your research.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Warm but brief — the tone of dismissal that is also encouragement. A small nod in the voice. Not effusive, but unmistakably approving.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験データの内部取調べを進めております
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm working through the experimental data now.
lines.style: Quiet, focused. The closer — his voice settles into the work itself. Steady, almost meditative. Not rushed, but purposeful. A man at work.
